protocol.execution: weekly Monday UTC target change, next 15m open
protocol.exposure: target_vol / realized_vol, clipped to configured minimum and 1.5x
protocol.funding: exposure above 1x capped to 1x when last known funding exceeds 0.01%
protocol.costs: 10 bps fee + 5 bps slippage on changed notional
protocol.selection: maximize weaker research/validation excess; OOS excluded
